title: Chapter 7 — The Brotherhood
description: Cult path: study, initiation and the first Shell job. Independent path: the Ọmọ Onílẹ̀ drivers' co-op.

cards.title: Act 3 — The Brotherhood
cards.text: Day {stat:day}. Professor is out of hospital, walking with a stick he insists is "for style".

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Study time. Initiation is tonight. Listen well, because I will only say this once. Okay, twice. Okay, as many times as you need, but don't tell anybody.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: How many knocks open the shell? Two. NEVER three. Three is for Hyenas and people knocking on the wrong door.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Where does a Tortoise keep his money? In the register. Signed, stamped, filed. Money without paper is just paper without money.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: And if they ask what the Tortoise says to the Hyena: nothing. The Tortoise files a report. Always a report.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Form T-12: membership. Nine pages. In triplicate. If you remember nothing else, remember the triplicate.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Any questions?

options.text: "I don hear. Make I go hustle."

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: (he looks around very slowly) That is the one question you never ask. Nobody knows. And nobody asks. ...Did you hear what I just said? Remember it.

beats.objective: Hustle until night. Initiation at the Shell House (Tenement A, south street) at 8 p.m.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The candle goes out. Somebody says "Correction session" in the tone of a man reading minutes.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: (pressing ice wrapped in a file folder to your face) You passed. Barely. In this society, "barely" is still a stamp.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: From behind a curtain, a voice nobody can place: "File him as {rank}." Applause. Slow, bureaucratic applause.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Everybody saw you fight back with two wrong answers. They don't respect the answers. They respect the fighting.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: Your first allowance. Cult funds, not pocket money. Never mix the two. That is how Hyenas are born.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: SHELL WORK is at this house whenever you want it. Hyenas keep touching our bus stops. Remove them. Politely. With hands.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: (the next morning, looking at your yellow scarf) Hm. Yellow suits you. Shame about the rest.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: You smell like candle wax and bad decisions. Wetin you join?

beats.title: End of Chapter 7 — The Brotherhood
beats.summary: You are a Tortoise: {rank}. Cult funds {cultMoney}. Hyena hatred {stat:rivalCultHatred}.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Listen. Every driver for this junction dey pay three, four people: union, Scatter, Task Force, cult. What if dem pay one co-operative, and the co-op protect dem?

beats.speaker: biodun
beats.text: I dey inside. 'God's Time Is The Best' need structure. And a fair fee wey I fit plan with.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Bíọ́dún is not here. He says he will join "when the chaser becomes the protector". Fair.

beats.speaker: iyaKeke
beats.text: Me, I no dey pay agbero. But co-operative? Co-operative get minutes. I like minutes. I dey.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: We need one rule to start. Wetin be our rule?

options.text: One fair fee for everybody, written on a board.
Members pay half. Non-members pay full.
Every member saves ₦200 a day for emergencies.

cards.title: Ọmọ Onílẹ̀ Drivers' Co-operative
cards.text: A hand-painted board goes up beside Ada's Corner. Somebody spells "co-operative" with three o's. Nobody corrects it. It is perfect.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: (arriving with suya) Co-operative. In my park. (He chews for a long time.) The tortoise that wants to carry the elephant... no, wait. The elephant that... Hm. We go see.

beats.speaker: chuks
beats.text: A co-op! Beautiful paperwork. Our offer stands: register your co-op with the Shell. A small annual fee. For filing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Behind him, two boys in purple are laughing at the board. One of them writes "HA HA" under the three o's.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (The Hyena boys want a "laughing tax" from the co-op drivers.)

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Co-operative. (He smiles with his three good fingers.) Twenty years I wait for somebody to try this. Make dem no kill you for am.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: CO-OP DAY collections are open at the Front Stop. The money goes to your hustle savings, not your pocket.

beats.title: End of Chapter 7 — Ọmọ Onílẹ̀
beats.summary: The co-op is born. Goodwill {stat:communityGoodwill}. Hustle savings {hustleMoney}.
